config.title: Notes Explorer
config.rootPath: Folder that holds your notes. Leave empty to pick one from the Notes view.
config.hiddenFolders: Folder names to hide from the tree, tasks and search.
config.sortBy.name: Alphabetical
config.sortBy: How notes are sorted in the tree. Folders are always listed first.
config.showModifiedTime: Show when each note was last modified (for example `2h ago`).
config.showStatusBar: Show the open task count in the status bar.
config.reminders: Notify about open tasks with `@due(YYYY-MM-DD)` that are due today or overdue.
config.dateFormat: Format for `{{date}}` in templates. Tokens: `YYYY MM DD HH mm ss MMMM MMM dddd ddd`; text in `[brackets]` is kept as is.
config.templatesFolder: Folder (inside the notes folder) holding note templates. Placeholders: `{{title}}`, `{{date}}`, `{{time}}`, `{{date:FORMAT}}`, `{{cursor}}`.
config.daily.folder: Folder (inside the notes folder) for daily notes.
config.daily.fileNameFormat: File name format for daily notes, using the same tokens as `#notesExplorer.dateFormat#`.
config.daily.template: Template file (in the templates folder) used for new daily notes.
config.capture.note: Note (relative to the notes folder) that Quick Capture appends to.
config.capture.format: Line format for Quick Capture. For example `- [ ] {{text}}` for tasks, or `- {{time}} {{text}}`.
config.pasteImages.enabled: Save images pasted or dropped into notes to `#notesExplorer.pasteImages.folder#` next to the note. Uses VS Code's built-in Markdown paste.
config.pasteImages.folder: Folder, relative to each note, where pasted images are saved.
config.mask.patterns: Regular expressions for values to hide on screen in notes. Capture group 1 is hidden if present, otherwise the whole match. Example: `(?:password|pwd)\s*[:=]\s*(\S+)`. Empty = masking off.
config.projectsFolder: Folder (inside the notes folder) where Open Project Notes creates a folder for the current project.
description: Your notes folder in the sidebar of every VS Code window: tasks, reminders, daily notes, templates, [[links]] and tags.
virtualWorkspaces: Notes Explorer reads your notes folder from disk.
command.archiveCompleted: Move Completed Tasks to Archive Section
config.links.reportMissing: Mark `[[links]]` to notes that don't exist, with a quick fix to create the note.
config.links.hoverPreview: Show the beginning of a linked note when hovering a `[[link]]`.
config.links.previewLines: How many lines the `[[link]]` hover preview shows.
config.links.updateOnRename: When a note is renamed, update `[[links]]` that point to it.
config.tasks.stampCompletion: Append `✓ YYYY-MM-DD` when a task is marked done from the Tasks view or a board.
config.tasks.archiveHeading: Heading that *Move Completed Tasks to Archive Section* moves finished tasks under.
config.kanban.doneColumn: Board column name that marks cards as done when they are dropped into it.
config.calendar.weekStart: First day of the week in the calendar.
config.export.browserPath: Path to Edge, Chrome or Chromium used for PDF export. Empty = find one automatically.
